|arg= local

|eff= global

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Lock all cargo positions of a vehicle or lock by index.
This command will remove user "get in" action (not get out) but will also stop player getting into vehicle via script commands (e.g [[moveInCargo]]) unlike [[lock]] command.

|s1= vehicle [[lockCargo]] lock

|p1= vehicle: [[Object]]

|p2= lock: [[Boolean]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|s2= vehicle [[lockCargo]] [index, lock]

|p21= vehicle: [[Object]]

|p22= index: [[Number]]

|p23= lock: [[Boolean]]

|r2= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>vehicleName lockCargo true;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>vehicleName lockCargo [0, true];</sqf>

|seealso= [[lock]] [[setVehicleLock]] [[lockDriver]] [[lockedCargo]] [[lockTurret]]
